title: Purair® CAGEX Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber
meta_title: Purair CAGEX Cyanoacrylate Fuming Chamber | Air Science
meta_description: The Purair CAGEX cyanoacrylate fuming chamber is engineered to protect users and the environment from animal dander and bedding particulates during cage changes and waste disposal.
meta_keywords: cyanoacrylate fuming chamber, animal research, cage changing, waste disposal, air filtration, HEPA, carbon filter
short_description: Engineered to meet the needs of the animal research laboratory, the Purair® CAGEX is designed to protect the user and the environment from animal dander or bedding material particulates generated on the work surface. The CAGEX incorporates carbon filters to absorb odor while optional HEPA filtration contains harmful particulates generated during cage changing and waste disposal operations.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair CAGEX creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the animal research industry. Key features include a high-efficiency EC blower, energy-saving LED lighting, filter blockage alarm, improved filter clamping to eliminate bypass leakage, easy-to-change filters, a mounted waste container for rapid disposal, a durable chemically resistant cabinet frame with easy-to-clean work surfaces, a hinged front sash for easy access, and an optional mobile cart for ergonomic use and maximum flexibility. The Purair CAGEX construction complies with current technical and safety regulations.
seo_content: The Purair CAGEX cyanoacrylate fuming chamber is designed to provide a safe, controlled environment for a wide range of animal research applications, including cage cleaning, bedding changes, and waste disposal. Its advanced filtration system, featuring both carbon and optional HEPA filters, effectively captures and contains animal dander, bedding particulates, and other airborne contaminants, protecting both the user and the surrounding environment. With its robust construction, user-friendly features, and compliance with key safety and environmental standards, the CAGEX is an essential tool for modern animal research laboratories.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CFR, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
